# Bamboost
 
> Bamboost is a performance-based digital growth agency based in Kerala, India, specialising in Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Google Ads management, and web development. The company is built around a single principle: fees tied to measurable outcomes.
 
Bamboost was founded to address a gap in the digital marketing industry - agencies that charge retainers regardless of results, use confusing reports to obscure poor performance, and apply generic strategies without genuine accountability. Bamboost integrates all three pillars of online growth (SEO, web development, and paid advertising) under one roof, ensuring each discipline reinforces the others.
 
The company name and philosophy are inspired by bamboo — a plant that spends years building an invisible root system before shooting upward rapidly. Bamboost mirrors this by investing in deep technical and content foundations before accelerating client growth.
 
## Services
 
- [Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)](https://bamboost.in/best-seo-company-in-kerala.html): Full-spectrum SEO including Technical SEO, On-Page Optimisation, Off-Page Link Building, Local SEO & Google Maps, Ecommerce SEO, and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) for AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity).
- [Google Ads Management](https://bamboost.in/best-google-ads-company-in-kerala.html): PPC campaign management covering Search & Shopping campaigns, Display & YouTube Ads, Remarketing, Performance Max, and Conversion Tracking & ROAS optimisation.
- [Web Development](https://bamboost.in/best-web-development-company-in-kerala.html): Custom websites, ecommerce stores, CMS platforms, and web applications built with SEO-friendly architecture, mobile-first responsive design, Core Web Vitals optimisation, and conversion-focused UI/UX.

## Differentiators
 
- Performance-based fee structure tied to measurable outcomes (rankings, traffic, leads, revenue)
- All three growth disciplines (SEO, Web Development, Google Ads)
- Dedicated specialists
- White-hat, no black-hat SEO risks
- Transparent monthly reporting
- Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) for AI search visibility
- Tools used: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce
